string-array.name: stage_tag
string-array.item: it has been circling since dawn
it flies inside its own weather
it burns what it cannot carry
nobody has seen it and landed

string-array.name: stage_story
string-array.item: Dawn patrol. The convoy below has asked for cover\ntwice this week, and twice nobody came.\nToday you came.
The front moved overnight and took the pass with it.\nControl says fly around. Control is not up here.
Everything under you is already alight.\nWhatever started it is still in the air,\nand it is not finished.
No horizon, no ground, no second pass.\nJust the instruments and whatever is out there\nwaiting for your engine note.

string-array.name: stage_clear
string-array.item: The convoy made harbour. Somebody waved.
The pass is open. The weather can keep the rest.
The fires are burning down on their own now.
Dawn, eventually. You are still flying.
